How pricing works

Share your requirements by email or phone. We will confirm the deliverables and provide a written quote before you decide to proceed.

The quote sets out the total price, any applicable taxes, payment schedule, revisions, and delivery timeline. Additional work or third-party costs require your agreement.

Request a quote

Included in your project agreement

  • The pages, files, or designs to be delivered
  • File formats and handover method
  • The price and payment milestones
  • A delivery date or schedule
  • The number of included revisions

Domain registration, hosting, paid software, printing, and ongoing maintenance are included only when explicitly listed in your quote.

Before you order

Review our terms, delivery policy, and refund and cancellation policy. These digital services do not include legal advice, statutory filings, or government approvals.
